BiblicalUsage: Bondage, slavery, the yoke Christ came to break, and the fear of death that held people in bondage all their lives. Paul contrasts the Jerusalem below, which is in bondage with her children, with the freedom of the Jerusalem above, and says we did not receive the spirit of bondage again to fear.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Christ broke the bondage I could not break myself, and freedom is not the absence of a master but the presence of the right one. I stand fast in the liberty He bought, because going back to bondage would make His cross pointless.
